title: Round-trip of a marked block through the aux list
statement: Let $w \in \bbn$ and let $b$ be a nonempty list of pairs in $\mathrm{Fin}\,w \times \mathrm{Bool}$. If one first marks the last entry of $b$ (setting the marker flag to true on the final pair and false on all others) and then converts the resulting list of triples back into an aux list, the outcome is the list obtained from $b$ by casting each pair $(i, d)$ to the entry $(i, d) \in \bbn \times \mathrm{Bool}$, followed by the single termination marker $(w, \mathrm{false})$.
hypotheses_covered: block is a list of Fin w × Bool pairs
replaced:
On a nonempty block, $\mathrm{triplesToAux}(\mathrm{markLast}\,block)$ equals the
block mapped into $\mathbb{N} \times \mathrm{Bool}$ followed by a single
$(w, \mathrm{false})$ termination marker.
